offering_description.value: PTC sells software to companies that design, manufacture, and maintain physical products. Its portfolio supports work from engineering through production and service, and includes cloud-based product development software.

quotes.quote: From planes to medical devices to wind turbines to computers, our unique portfolio of software solutions enables companies to transform how they design, make, and maintain their products.
Our software is helping to advance products all around us. See how our modern SaaS technology is transforming product development.
